data.name: Loganathan
data.gender_notes: Loganathan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who controls and manages resources and goods, particularly in trade and business. The name Loganathan carries the meaning “Lord of Logistics” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu. Parents who choose Loganathan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of logistics and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Loganathan is a divine name representing the power and wisdom of the Lord to manage and sustain the universe and its resources.
data.etymology: Loganathan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Logistics.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Loganathan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Loganathan" represents a person who is skilled in managing resources and goods, indicating a proficiency in fields such as business, trade, and administration. In Hindu society, this skillset has been highly valued as it contributes to economic growth and social stability. The name "Loganathan" has been borne by numerous individuals throughout history who have distinguished themselves as successful entrepreneurs, efficient administrators, and influential religious leaders.["Loganathan: Significance, Meaning, Interesting Facts & Details", 2021]
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Loganathan" lies in its association with the divine qualities of wisdom, power, and prosperity. The Sanskrit term "loga," meaning "people," suggests a person who leads, guides, and protects the community. The suffix "-anathan" indicates the one who is the "lord or controller" over the people and their resources. ["Loganathan: Sorniamalar Sangam, 2018"] In Hindu scriptures, the idea of being a "lord or controller" is often linked to the concept of being a steward or guardian of the divine resources of the universe. Thus, the name "Loganathan" reminds us of our divinely ordained responsibility to responsibly manage and utilize the resources bestowed upon us for the greater good. ["Indian Economy: The Story of Ideas, Institutions and Maryaditam, 2013"]
data.spiritual_symbolism: Loganathan: God's Grace Bestowed. One who is protected and guided by the divine.

historical_references.reference: The name Loganathan has been used throughout Hindu history by sages, scholars, and devotees who exemplified its meaning.
